result.description:
The City of Randwick is a local government area in the eastern suburbs of Sydney, NSW. One of Sydney's largest parks, Centennial Park, lies within the city boundary of Randwick. Randwick became a city in 1990 and is 36 km² in area and home to 145,800 people.

https://www.randwick.nsw.gov.au/

Randwick's flood management programs for Maroubra Bay, Coogee Bay, Green Square - West Kensington and Kensington - Centennial Park are available: 
https://www.randwick.nsw.gov.au/environment-and-sustainability/what-were-doing/managing-flooding
